We could move this inside the `cssClasses` options of the `refinementList` it would allow a user to override it. IIRC we already have this feedback.
The `SearchBox` don't have to own this logic, the caller can create the correct template object.

Not sure to understand why you have to check for `searchAsYouType`. With a stalled network the widgets are re-rendered with the last results (with the last state). In that case we have an issue: the internal state is more fresh that the props.
